answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 153333 Country: India Title: (1) After doing ablution (wudhu), most of the time I have doubt that whether I have done masah of head or not. What should I do in this situation? Question: (1) After doing ablution (wudhu), most of the time I have doubt that whether I have done masah of head or not. What should I do in this situation? Answer ID: 153333 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1167/1178/SN=11/1438) Your doubts are mere suppositions. However, perform wudhu attentively. Yet if you have doubts then pay no attention towards it and offer salah with this wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
